clues.text: John said he was on this island because of the word of God and his testimony about Jesus.
On this island, John was in the Spirit on the Lord's day and heard a loud voice like a trumpet.
While on this island, John was told to write in a book what he saw and send it to seven churches.
On this island, John turned to see who was speaking and saw seven golden lampstands.
On this island, John saw One like the Son of Man holding seven stars in His right hand.
On this island, John fell like a dead man at the feet of One who told him not to be afraid.
Writing to seven churches in Asia, John called himself their partner in tribulation while on this island.
